title: Direct summands of a relatively pseudo-coherent object are relatively pseudo-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For X -> S locally of finite type, m in Z and objects E, K of D(O_X), if the direct sum E (+) K is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S then so are E and K separately. The retained proof is written: follow from Cohomology, lemma summands-pseudo-coherent (absolute direct-summand stability of m-pseudo-coherent objects) and the definitions — on each smooth chart the relative condition is the absolute one on the representing complex, and absolute summand stability descends to each summand chart by chart, with no further author argument. Retained author proof at lines 17076-17080.
